sources.primary_title: WE Solutions and Movandi Announce Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Advanced Wireless Deployment in Saudi Arabia
sources.verified_angle_summary: WE Solutions and Movandi announced a strategic partnership at LEAP 2026 to accelerate the deployment of advanced wireless connectivity technologies across Saudi Arabia. The collaboration combines Movandi’s mmWave, RF semiconductor, beamforming, smart repeater, and software-defined networking technologies with WE Solutions’ local engineering, systems integration, cybersecurity, and project-delivery capabilities. The partnership aims to help customers transition rapidly from technology evaluation to real-world implementation in telecommunications, government, giga-projects, transport, enterprise, and critical infrastructure environments. This angle focuses on the integration and deployment enablement of next-generation wireless systems in the Kingdom, which is distinct from Movandi's separate MoU with ACES that targets 5G/6G infrastructure localization.
sources.verified_key_facts: WE Solutions and Movandi formed a strategic partnership via MoU; Announced on August 31, 2026, coinciding with LEAP 2026; Focuses on accelerating advanced wireless deployment in Saudi Arabia; Combines Movandi's mmWave/RF tech with WE Solutions' local integration capabilities; Targets telecommunications, government, giga-projects, transport, and critical infrastructure; Maryam Rofougaran is CEO of Movandi; Mike Bramwell is Managing Director of WE Solutions.
